title: 12.12. Upādānadukādi, Hetuduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Hetuyā pañca, vipāke ekaṁ …pe… avigate pañca.
Nokilesaṁ nahetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… nanokilesaṁ nahetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā nava …pe… vipāke ekaṁ …pe… avigate nava.
